name: ui-design-system
description: Generates complete design systems before frontend implementation. Curated mode adapts a vendored real-world reference (Stripe, Linear, Notion, ...), guided mode asks 7 questions, quick mode takes a one-liner; five OKLch directions and a WCAG contrast check on every text pair. Auto-detects Blazor, React, Vue, Astro stacks. Outputs docs/design/MASTER.md for consumption by ui-workflow ui-phase.
